messages:
javier (customer): hey team, I tried to apply the promo code 'SpringBoost-2026' at checkout and the API returned 'invalid_or_expired'. dashboard shows the code active for my org tho. Can someone check?

jess_support: sorry about that — can you paste the exact code and the email you used? also which endpoint (web/checkout/in-app)?

javier (customer): code is SpringBoost-2026 (copied from partner email). email is javier@acme.com. used web checkout. happened twice around 11:16am PST.

jess_support: thanks. i'm going to look up the claim logs and escalate if needed. i'll DM for any PII.

jess_support: @cora_eng any quick ideas? we saw similar reports last month but those were unicode whitespace. this one looks ascii.
cora_eng: pinged — can you grab the request id + proxied header for one of the failed requests? I want the normalized code we got vs what's in the promos DB.
jess_support: pulling logs now. request-id=req_0a1b2c3d, timestamp=1769456798. raw_code="SpringBoost-2026". service normalized to "springboost-2026" before lookup. DB stored key is "SpringBoost-2026". lookup returned miss -> rejected as INVALID.
cora_eng: ahhh. looks like the promo-service introduced aggressive casefolding in a recent change (auto-lowercase all codes) but our DB is case-sensitive for older codes. patch diff: ```- normalized = raw_code``` ```+ normalized = raw_code.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)``` 
jess_support: so old mixed-case codes will fail if normalization changed mid-migration?
cora_eng: yep. new behavior broke backwards compatibility. visible in logs: code_lookup(normalized="springboost-2026") -> miss; fallback not attempted.
lee_billing: can we manually credit the account while eng fixes? customer needs the trial credit for onboarding.
jess_support: yes, i'll apply a one-time 30-day trial credit and mark it as manual grant. updating now.
jess_support: applied 30-day trial to org acme (javier@acme.com). txn id=tx_manual_9843. emailed confirmation. :white_check_mark:
javier (customer): thanks! appreciate the quick help. will wait for the fix so future new users aren't blocked.
cora_eng: plan: roll back normalization in promo-service to previous behavior in the next 30m, then deploy a compatibility shim that tries both normalized and raw lookups for 48h. i'll open the PR and request fast-track.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: rollback to v2.14.3 (promo-service). ETA ~18m. CI green.
jess_support: keeping thread open until deploy completes and we confirm successful claims.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: promo-service v2.14.3 restored, 12:05 UTC. smoke tests: promo lookup for SpringBoost-2026 -> hit.
cora_eng: confirmed with live test: backend returns 200 and grants trial when code used. setting follow-up task to run a migration to normalize DB keys or update docs about case-sensitivity.
jess_support: closing for now, re-open if you see it again. tagging billing for manual txn reconciliation: @lee_billing.
lee_billing: got it — will reconcile the manual credit and mark it in billing ledger.
javier (customer): all good, tested on my end and it worked. thanks everyone! :rocket:
